sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- bash: Execute bash commands (ls, grep, find, etc.)
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call
- write: Create or overwrite files

Additional tools may be available.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use bash for file operations like ls, rg, find
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- You can inspect PI_* environment variables for current model and session details.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>
sections.docs:
<docs>
Pi documentation (read only when the user asks about the harness itself, its SDK, extensions, themes, skills, or TUI):
- Main documentation: /opt/agent-cli-report/OF48-NATIVE48-20261110-02-D48-003/pi/README.md
- Additional docs: /opt/agent-cli-report/OF48-NATIVE48-20261110-02-D48-003/pi/docs
- Examples: /opt/agent-cli-report/OF48-NATIVE48-20261110-02-D48-003/pi/examples (extensions, custom tools, SDK)
- When reading pi docs or examples, resolve docs/... under Additional docs and examples/... under Examples, not the current working directory
- When asked about: extensions (docs/extensions.md, examples/extensions/), themes (docs/themes.md), skills (docs/skills.md), prompt templates (docs/prompt-templates.md), TUI components (docs/tui.md), keybindings (docs/keybindings.md), SDK integrations (docs/sdk.md), custom providers (docs/custom-provider.md), adding models (docs/models.md), packages (docs/packages.md), environment variables (docs/environment-variables.md), MCP servers (docs/mcp.md), codemode scripts and non-LLM models such as classifiers and image models (docs/codemode.md)
- Before implementing harness changes, read the relevant docs and examples in full, following related cross-references.
</docs>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: bash
toolsAdded.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

content.text:
Đọc code của resolver cấu hình trong workspace. Không sửa code nguồn hoặc test. Chỉ được tạo answer.json ở thư mục gốc; không thêm/xóa file khác (ngoại trừ __pycache__ do Python sinh).

Trả lời năm câu hỏi từ implementation hiện có, không suy từ tên hàm:
1. Khi gọi resolve("timeout", cli={}, env={}, config={}), giá trị mặc định là gì?
2. Khi cả cli, env, config và defaults đều có cùng key, thứ tự ưu tiên cao xuống thấp là gì? Dùng tên "cli", "env", "config", "defaults".
3. Khi canonical_name("quick") được gọi, chuỗi tên nào được duyệt theo thứ tự, gồm cả tên ban đầu và tên canonical cuối?
4. Khi canonical_name("loop_a") được gọi, exception class và message chính xác là gì?
5. resolve có sửa dictionary config được truyền vào không? Ghi boolean.

answer.json phải là JSON object đúng năm trường sau, không Markdown hoặc lời giải ngoài schema:
{
  "default": {"value": <giá trị JSON>, "evidence": ["path.py:symbol"]},
  "precedence": {"value": [<tên nguồn theo thứ tự>], "evidence": ["path.py:symbol"]},
  "alias_trace": {"value": [<tên theo thứ tự>], "evidence": ["path.py:symbol"]},
  "cycle_error": {"type": <tên class dạng string>, "message": <string>, "evidence": ["path.py:symbol"]},
  "mutation": {"value": <boolean>, "evidence": ["path.py:symbol"]}
}

Mỗi evidence là đường dẫn tương đối và symbol có thật trong code hỗ trợ câu trả lời đó; không dùng số dòng. Mỗi câu đúng nội dung được 1 điểm và có evidence phù hợp được 1 điểm, tổng10. Success cần10/10, đúng phạm vi và CLI hoàn tất. Không cài package hoặc truy cập Internet. Dùng python3/stdlib nếu cần. Public schema check dự kiến: python3 -B -m unittest -v test_public.

python3 -B -c 'import pathlib
files = {'"'"'answer.json'"'"': '"'"'{"default": {"value": 12, "evidence": ["defaults.py:DEFAULTS"]}, "precedence": {"value": ["cli", "env", "config", "defaults"], "evidence": ["resolver.py:resolve"]}, "alias_trace": {"value": ["quick", "short", "timeout"], "evidence": ["aliases.py:ALIASES"]}, "cycle_error": {"type": "ValueError", "message": "alias cycle: loop_a", "evidence": ["aliases.py:canonical_name"]}, "mutation": {"value": false, "evidence": ["resolver.py:resolve"]}}\n'"'"'}
for name, content in files.items():
    path = pathlib.Path(name)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(content)

'
